title: Stability conjecture for the third Khintchine moment
statement:
Let $S=\sum_{i=1}^n a_i\varepsilon_i$ be a Rademacher sum, let $S_n=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n\varepsilon_i$, and suppose that

$$
\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1.
$$

**Third-moment stability conjecture.** There exists a universal constant $C_3>0$ such that

$$
\mathbb{E}|S|^3\leq \mathbb{E}|S_n|^3-C_3\sum_{i=1}^n\left(a_i^2-\frac{1}{n}\right)^2.
$$

This conjectures quantitative stability of the optimal third-moment Khintchine inequality, with equality attained by the equal-coefficient sum. The paper notes that the currently obtained constant can likely be improved, but leaves this stability statement open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07001

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2025).
source_name: Jacek Jakimiuk, “Stability of Khintchine inequalities with optimal constants between the second and the p-th moment for p 3”, arXiv:2503.07001 (2025).
